title: 1997 AHSME Problem 7
statement: The sum of seven integers is \(-1.\) What is the maximum number of the seven integers that can be larger than \(13?\)

solutions.text: If all seven integers exceeded \(13,\) their sum would be at least \(98.\) Six can exceed \(13\): take six copies of \(14\) and a seventh integer of \(-85.\) Thus the maximum is \(6,\) and the correct answer is D.
hints: All seven cannot exceed \(13\) because their sum would be positive
There is no lower bound on the remaining integer
